hero.title: Study Public Health in USA for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Public health constitutes an interdisciplinary discipline dedicated to enhancing the health status and overall well-being of communities and populations. In contrast to clinical healthcare, which predominantly addresses the diagnosis and treatment of individual patients, public health emphasizes disease prevention, health promotion, health education, healthcare infrastructure, and population-based health concerns.
